tools.name: get_tweet
tools.description: Get caption, author, and media download links for a public X post.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-bgpt-tweet-downloader" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tweet · Public sink: get_tweet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tweet · Public sink: get_tweet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "bgpt_tweet_downloader" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
